title.narrative: Support Programme to the implementation of the EU-SADC EPA in SA

description.narrative: The Action will support inclusive sustainable growth, job creation and youth employment (country priority 3) through a programme that aims to support the implementation of the EU-SADC EPA. It will focus on working with key government departments namely the Department of Trade and Industry and the Department of Agriculture Forestry and Fisheries as well as civil society, public and private institutions to overcome non-trade barriers and Sanitary and Phyto-Sanitary issues.
